projects.title: Sunset Tower | Games
projects.description:
Most of my games are higher quality than this one - make sure you check out my profile :) I made this one in less than a day for fun, and it is not the standard I usually hold myself to. 

Welcome to Sunset Tower, my newest game! I had always wanted to make a game with an orange color palette, and thus the idea for this project was born! While it is definitely far from my best game, I'm satisfied with the overall aesthetic this provides, and figured it was worth sharing. Please leave a love and favorite, and follow if you enjoy!

Cloud scores don't seem to be functioning anymore. Previous high score was 256 :)

Quick note - I won’t be home for much of today, so if there are any glitches it’ll take a day or two for me to work on them :)

Please report any and all bugs you come across. I had to rush to finish this game, as I have to go to a college tour early in the morning, but wanted to get this finished on time first.

Want to see more fun arcade-style games that are fairly unique? Feel free to follow! While this was a bit of a filler project, my next few projects are going to be full fledged games :D

♥ ☆ ♥ ☆ ♥ ☆

Instructions: Click, tap, or press any key to launch yourself upwards towards the next platform. But be warned - your platform is always moving too, meaning that if you miss the platform above you, the platform below is not always going to be there to catch you!

♥ ☆ ♥ ☆ ♥ ☆

Credits: All art and code was by me, @RacingAce, except - 
 ♥ Score code was a modified engine by my friend @kevin_eleven_1234
 ♥ Art was inspired by @Supermushy - go check them out :D
 ♥ Music is Counting Stars (8bit) by OneRepublic and I believe the NES password screen song?

Thanks for playing, and I hope you enjoyed! 
Hailey <3

projects.title: Super Square
projects.instructions:
Help Super Square evade enemies and collect coins in this strategic grid based game!

❤️⭐and FOLLOW me (@KEVEK) if you enjoyed this!

[ Instructions ]
> Click on the arrow buttons to move.
> Avoid enemies and going off the grid.
> You get a point for every move you make.
> Collect coins to earn 3 points.
> Red enemies move in a straight line.
> Orange enemies move randomly.

projects.title: Detective Pingu
projects.instructions:
————————— Eɴɢʟɪsʜ —————————
 Dᴇᴛᴇᴄᴛɪᴠᴇ Pɪɴɢᴜ - A ɢᴀᴍᴇ ʙʏ AʟɢᴜɪᴇɴCᴏɴᴛᴇɴᴛᴏ
         ⠀⠀• ✦ •

Welcome to Detective Pingu! ᵔᴗᵔ Investigate a crime, obtain objects and help other penguins in this cute game.

This game...
⠀• contains >4.6k blocks, >75 sprites and 2 minigames
⠀• took me about 9 months of development
⠀• was made by me, but is a collaboration with other
⠀⠀Scratchers! (more information below)
⠀• won the 4th place in @theCharpy's Blazing Cup :D

        ✦ Sᴛᴏʀʏ ✦
Pingu is a private detective in a penguin town in Antartica. He's just received another case: someone has stolen the painter Pinguinardo da Vinci's paintbrush. Will you help Pingu solve the mystery before the painting contest ends?

       ✦ Iɴsᴛʀᴜᴄᴛɪᴏɴs ✦
There's an in-game tutorial. If you forget the controls or want to change the settings, open the menu by clicking the gear button.

This game has an automatic save system. You can copy your save code and continue playing later by loading your code.

The project runs very slowly? Try...
⠀• charging your device to have more battery
⠀• closing other windows or tabs
⠀• using another device (computer recommended)
⠀• open it here: https://turbowarp.org/818485188/

If you have any questions, feel free to ask me in the comments :)

         ✦ Nᴏᴛᴇs ✦
This game wasn't originally supposed to be an entry for @theCharpy's contest (The Blazing Cup) but I was developing it when the contest came out, so I decided to participate! :) (I'm sure I won't win anything though xD)

If you find any bugs or spelling/grammar mistakes, please tell me so that I can fix them as soon as possible!

        ✦ Cʀᴇᴅɪᴛs ✦
The full credits are in the project, but here's a quick summary:
⠀• Almost everything made by @AlguienContento
⠀• Thanks to @griffpatch, @Zinnea and @qucchia for
⠀⠀some of the code
⠀• Thanks to @Do0dle_Bits, @Clmasa, @E-fan and
⠀⠀@pupcky_alt, the Scratchers whose drawings
⠀⠀I used in the game :)
⠀• Sound effects from the Scratch library and other
⠀⠀sources
⠀• And thank you for playing! ᵔᴗᵔ



————————— Esᴘᴀɴ̃ᴏʟ —————————
 Dᴇᴛᴇᴄᴛɪᴠᴇ Pɪɴɢᴜ - Uɴ ᴊᴜᴇɢᴏ ᴅᴇ AʟɢᴜɪᴇɴCᴏɴᴛᴇɴᴛᴏ
         ⠀⠀• ✦ •

¡Bienvenid@ a Detective Pingu! ᵔᴗᵔ Investiga un crimen, obtén objetos y ayuda a otros pingüinos en este agradable juego.

Este juego...
⠀• contiene >4.600 bloques, 75 objetos y 2 minijuegos
⠀• me llevó alrededor de 9 meses de desarrollo
⠀• está hecho por mí, pero ¡es una colaboración con
⠀⠀otros Scratchers! (más información abajo)
⠀• ganó el 4º lugar en The Blazing Cup de @theCharpy
⠀⠀:D

        ✦ Hɪsᴛᴏʀɪᴀ ✦
Pingu es un detective privado en un pueblo de pingüinos en la Antártida. Acaban de encargarle otro caso: han robado el pincel del pintor Pingüinardo da Vinci. ¿Ayudarás a Pingu a resolver el misterio antes de que se acabe el plazo del concurso de pintura?

       ✦ Iɴsᴛʀᴜᴄᴄɪᴏɴᴇs ✦
Hay un tutorial dentro del juego. Si te olvidas de los controles o quieres cambiar la configuración, abre el menú haciendo click en el botón del engranaje.

Este juego tiene un sistema de guardado automático. Puedes copiar tu código de guardado y continuar jugando más tarde cargando el código.

¿El proyecto va muy despacio? Intenta...
⠀• cargar tu dispositivo para tener más batería
⠀• cerrar otras ventanas o pestañas
⠀• usar otro dispositivo (ordenador recomendado)
⠀• abrirlo aquí: https://turbowarp.org/818485188/

Si tienes alguna pregunta, puedes preguntarme en los comentarios :)

         ✦ Nᴏᴛᴀs ✦
Originalmente este juego no iba a ser una entrega para el concurso de @theCharpy (The Blazing Cup) pero lo estaba desarrollando cuando salió, ¡así que decidí participar! :) (Seguramente no gane nada de todas formas xD)

¡Si encuentras algún bug o errata, por favor, dímelo para que pueda solucionarlo lo más pronto possible!

        ✦ Cʀᴇ́ᴅɪᴛᴏs ✦
Los créditos completos están en el proyecto, pero aquí tienes un pequeño resumen:
⠀• Casi todo hecho por @AlguienContento
⠀• Gracias a @griffpatch, @Zinnea y @qucchia por
⠀⠀algo del código
⠀• Gracias a @Do0dle_Bits, @Clmasa, @E-fan y
⠀⠀@pupcky_alt, los Scratchers cuyos dibujos usé en
⠀⠀el juego :)
⠀• Efectos de sonido de la biblioteca de Scratch
⠀⠀y de otras fuentes
⠀• ¡Y gracias a ti por jugar! ᵔᴗᵔ

projects.title: Cotton Candy Screensaver
projects.description:
Fun fact: In 1897, Dr. Morrison teamed up with candy maker, John C. Wharton, and invented a machine that heated sugar in a spinning bowl, which had several tiny holes in it. The sugar in the hot, spinning bowl caramelized and made its way through the holes turning the melted sugar into light strands. They called this sugary treat “Fairy Floss”.

In 1904, the two inventors introduced their machine and fun snack at the St. Louis World’s Fair and sold 68,000 boxes over 6 months for 25¢ each ($6.75 in today’s money). The treat was so popular, a candy store purchased the electric machine and started selling the fairy floss just a year later.

However, the cotton candy we know and love today didn’t make its debut till the 19th century. Who introduced this sugary treat? Believe it or not, a dentist named Dr. William Morrison created cotton candy.

Intructions:
Press the green flag, choose the number of players and press the play button!
At the beginning, each player will place their first 3 marbles, you can only place it on the boxes with your color. 
Then, each turn, you must add 1 marble to a box
If there are 4 in the same box, they split. When they split, the 4 marbles in the box go to the 4 adjacent boxes (if it is on an edge, it will be removed), are added to those that were already there and change the color of the arrival box to their base color.
To win, you must annihilate your opponents by taking all their boxes, the winner is the last one in play.

With the music maker, you can create a simple piece of music. Simply use the arrow keys to position the cursor on the music staff, then press space bar to stamp the note. You can create music that plays multiple notes at the same time by positioning them on the same y-axis. To create longer notes, place multiple touching notes on the same x-axis. You can also adjust the tempo to speed up or slow down the music. To add accidentals, click the sharp, flat, or natural button. Light blue is sharp, dark blue is flat, and plain blue is natural. Enjoy!

projects.instructions:
A complete and functional interactive calculator and graph drawer.
Don't forget the litle heart ;) !
Just use "enter" or "=" to calculate...

––––– List of possible functions
 • * (press "*")
 • / (press "/" or "÷" or ":")
 • - (press "-")
 • + (press "+")
 • sin (press "s") / sin-1 (press "space" and "s")
 • cos (press "c") / cos-1 (press "space" and "c")
 • tan (press "t") / tan-1 (press "space" and "t")
 • modulo (press "m")
 • x^x (press "p")
 • fractions (use ()/()), see later
 • √ (press "v" or "√")
 • In (press "i")
 • Log (press "l")
 • ( & ) (press "(" or ")")
 • ? (press "x")
––––– How to make a fraction
Use this "(0)/(0)" and you will see a fraction appear !
––––– How to change theme
Click in the colorful eye in the bottom-right-hand-corner.
––––– In graphics option
Use up arrow to see the value of your current position
Use space and arrows to read values

Take a math !

Use Turbowarp for better velocity and pen : 
https://turbowarp.org/758788787?hqpen&limitless
